extracted.intended_audience: SAG-AFTRA members, actors and entertainment industry professionals (and general news readers)
extracted.subtask_description: A list of activities SAG-AFTRA members must withhold or avoid while the actors' strike is in effect — covering on- and off-camera work, background and stand-in work, promotional/publicity activities, negotiations, and use of digital replicas. Summarizes the union's memo of prohibited actions and related exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Withhold all covered TV/theatrical services
rubrics_metrics.description: Except as set forth in the Notice to Members Regarding Non-Struck Work, all covered services and performing work under the TV/theatrical contracts must be withheld.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a broad umbrella rule; the memo then lists specific covered services (both on-camera and off-camera) that are to be withheld. See the listed exceptions in the referenced Notice to Members Regarding Non-Struck Work for permitted non-struck activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principal on camera work
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal on camera work, such as: Acting; Singing; Dancing; Performing stunts; Piloting on-camera aircraft; Puppeteering; Performance capture or motion capture work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All such on-camera principal performances for TV/theatrical contracts must be withheld during the strike.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principal off camera work
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal off camera work, such as: ADR/Looping; TV Trailers (promos) and Theatrical Trailers; Voice Acting; Singing; Narration, including audio descriptive services except as the services may be covered by another collective bargaining agreement referred in the Notice to Members Regarding Non-Struck Work; Stunt coordinating and related services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes a variety of post-production and off-camera principal services tied to TV/theatrical contracts; some narration/audio descriptive services may be permitted if covered by another collective bargaining agreement per the Notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Background work
rubrics_metrics.description: Background work must be withheld under the strike rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stand-in work
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes any work performed as a stand-in for principal performers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photo and/or body doubles
rubrics_metrics.description: Photo and/or body doubles are included among services that must be withheld.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers use of doubles for camera, photography, or body-substitute purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fittings, wardrobe tests, and makeup tests
rubrics_metrics.description: Fittings, wardrobe tests, and makeup tests are prohibited while the strike is in effect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pre-production and preparation work directly tied to covered projects should be avoided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rehearsals and camera tests
rubrics_metrics.description: Rehearsals and camera tests must be withheld.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes on-set practice, blocking, and technical camera-related tests for covered productions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scanning
rubrics_metrics.description: Scanning is listed as a withheld activity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Likely refers to scanning/prior-work digitization or scanning for digital replica creation tied to covered projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interviews and auditions (including self-tape)
rubrics_metrics.description: Interviews and auditions (including via self-tape) are prohibited under the strike rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This prevents members from doing interviews for completed work and from participating in auditions or self-taped auditions for covered services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promotion of/publicity services for work under the TV/Theatrical Contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Promotion of/publicity services for work under the TV/Theatrical Contracts, such as: Tours; Personal appearances; Interviews; Conventions; Fan expos; Festivals; For your consideration events; Panels; Premieres/screenings; Award shows; Junkets; Podcast appearances; Social media; Studio showcases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Members may not promote projects covered by SAG-AFTRA contracts in person or via social media while the strike is in effect; this also includes attending festivals, premieres, award shows, conventions (e.g., Comic-Con) to promote past or present contracted work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Negotiating/entering into/consenting to agreements related to covered services
rubrics_metrics.description: Negotiating and/or entering into and/or consenting to: (a) An agreement to perform covered services in the future; (b) Any new agreement related to merchandising connected to a covered project; (c) The creation and use of digital replicas, including through the reuse of prior work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Members must not sign or consent to future performance agreements, merchandising deals tied to covered projects, or permit creation/use of digital replicas of their work during the strike.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performing on trailers or ancillary content connected to struck productions
rubrics_metrics.description: Performing on a trailer for a struck production or other ancillary content connected to a struck production is prohibited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This includes participation in promotional ancillary material tied to productions that are subject to the strike.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exceptions per Notice to Members Regarding Non-Struck Work
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain services may be permitted as set forth in the Notice to Members Regarding Non-Struck Work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The memo repeatedly references that the listed prohibitions apply 'except as set forth in the Notice to Members Regarding Non-Struck Work' — members should consult that Notice for permitted non-struck activities and any cross-covered-agreement exceptions (e.g., audio descriptive services covered by another CBA).
